==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|unlesse}} {{qualifier|obsolete}}
* {{l|en|unlessen}} {{q|US dialect}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=except if|:af|of<id:preposition>|on<id:>|upon<id:>|in<id:>|un-<id:>|less<id:>}}
From {{inh|en|enm|unlesse}}, earlier {{m|enm|on lesse}} (modern {{m|en|on}} + {{m|en|less}}), from {{m|enm||(not) on lesse (than)|t=(not) on a less compelling condition (than)}}. The quality of negation in the word and the lack of stress changed ''on'' to {{m|en|un-}}.<ref>{{R:Online Etymology Dictionary|pos=conj|v=4522}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ənˈlɛs/|/ʌnˈlɛs/}}
* {{IPA|en|/ʊnˈlɛs/|a=Northern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈlɛs/|a=US,nonstandard}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-unless.ogg|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-unless.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛs|s=2}}

===Conjunction===
{{en-head|conj}}

# [[except|Except]] on a [[specified]] [[condition]]; [[if]] [[not]].
#: {{uxi|en|I’m leaving '''unless''' I get a pay rise.}}
#: {{uxi|en|You can't go out '''unless''' it stops raining.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Unless''' part of the staff, you are not allowed beyond this point.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1839|author=Denison Olmsted|title=A Compendium of Astronomy|page=95
|passage=Secondly, When a body is once in motion it will continue to move forever, '''unless''' something stops it. When a ball is struck on the surface of the earth, the friction of the earth and the resistance of the air soon stop its motion.}}
# If not; {{non-gloss|used with counterfactual conditionals.}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|2 Samuel|2|27||And Joab said, As God liveth, '''unless''' thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.}}
# Except if; {{non-gloss|used with hypothetical conditionals.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1847|author=w:Emily Brontë|title=w:Wuthering Heights|chapter=III
|passage=Lie down and finish out the night, since you ''are'' here; but, for heaven's sake! don't repeat that horrid noise: nothing could excuse it, '''unless''' you were having your throat cut!}}

====Antonyms====
* {{antsense|except on a condition}} {{l|en|if}}

====Derived terms====
* {{l|en|precisely unless}}
* {{l|en|unlesss}}
* {{l|en|unless and until}}, {{l|en|until and unless}}
